title: Costed destruction TagDuel adapter — Exiled Force + Tribe-Infecting Virus

cards.name: Exiled Force
cards.officialText: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

cards.name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
cards.officialText: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

testCoverage: Exiled Force pays its own Tribute before the target prompt; no other target means activation is not offered
Exiled Force targets either team's monsters, including face-down monsters
Exiled Force target that leaves the field is not destroyed; effect negation does not refund the Tribute
Exiled Force Tribute is routed to the shared GY or Banished Zone when Banisher of the Light replaces GY destinations
Tribe-Infecting Virus discards from the active physical seat's private hand, not its inactive partner
Tribe accepts any card type as discard cost
Tribe resolves non-targeting against all face-up monsters of the declared race on both teams, including itself when matching
Face-down monsters and monsters of other races are excluded from Tribe's destruction result
Tribe accepts a declared race with no matching monsters
Tribe discard remains paid when the effect is negated at resolution
Banisher replacement applies to Tribe discard cost
Seven-card hand is not automatically trimmed; only the declared discard cost is paid
Open Main Phase/active-seat timing and 3-Monster-Zone limits are enforced
Physical UIDs, 20–30 Main Deck, 3+3 zones and Extra Deck 5 are conserved
fixtureStrategy: Production defaults retain the two official card IDs. Tests inject already-playable Normal Monster IDs as temporary aliases because these candidates are not yet admitted to engine-v9. Fixture aliases do not change metadata, certificates, allowlist, catalog or player inventory.
resolutionBoundary: Exiled Force returns one still-valid target UID; Tribe returns the current face-up matching-race UID set. The shared destruction pipeline remains responsible for actual destruction/replacement movement. Costs are paid in the adapter and preserve physical UID.
limitations: M61 still owns the protected resolver, metadata and certification files; this PR adds an isolated adapter only.
The adapter returns destruction UIDs to the shared pipeline rather than moving destroyed targets itself, so replacement effects and live Chain integration remain unverified.
The new card IDs are not yet playable/certified in engine-v9; adapter tests use fixture aliases and do not count as engine-v9 certification.
No live Discord gateway/guild, production database, merge, deploy or backup restoration was exercised.
